subject: Supply chain data paths + vendor roster reconciliation
messages:
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@finsecure.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Feb 2028 17:12:00 +0000
Subject: Vendor roster + data path questions for EU processing

Hi Vivek —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security team is doing a quick vendor roster reconciliation ahead of a scheduled audit and asked us to confirm a few things about Redwood's processing partners and cross-border flows. Can you please: 

- Share the current list of processing vendors (names, country of operations, and a short note on whether they act as subprocessors or infrastructure providers)
- Confirm which vendors may process or store EU-origin data outside the EEA and which safeguards you rely on (SCCs, adequacy, etc.)
- Provide an evidence stub for the KMS/HSM provider location for crypto key material (brief statement + contact or policy PDF is fine)

I've attached a filled roster template to make it easier (finsecure_vendor_roster_q1_2028.xlsx).

Can you get this to us by EOD Friday? If it's easier, a short call with your security lead will work.

Best,
Emma
Emma Jones | Security Programs Lead
FinSecure Ltd
-----
Attachment: finsecure_vendor_roster_q1_2028.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@finsecure.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Feb 2028 08:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor roster + data path questions for EU processing

Emma —

Thanks for the clear checklist. We're happy to provide the roster and the KMS/HSM stub. Quick notes before I populate the template: 

- We'll attach a current vendor roster and flag which entries are "subprocessor" vs "infrastructure".
- For cross-border flows: we rely on SCCs for certain transfers and have region-specific deployments for EU customers where possible; I'll flag region-specific hosts in the roster.
- KMS details: we can provide a one-page statement that notes provider, region of key residency, and reference to our KMS key policy. If you need an attestation from the KMS vendor we can coordinate but it may take extra time.

One ask: can you indicate whether the roster needs fields for "tokenization/keys", "logging vendor access", and "data-at-rest residence"? That will help us map the columns correctly.

I'll start a draft and loop Marissa to pull the roster from our procurement records.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0112
-----

Hi Vivek —

Thanks — the three extra columns would be perfect (tokenization/keys, logging vendor access, data-at-rest residence). I've attached a filled template and a short KMS evidence request PDF that our auditors prefer (kms-hsm-location-evidence-request.pdf).

If you can populate the roster with flags and a short note for each vendor on transfer mechanism (SCCs, adequacy, contractual clause), that's ideal. If anything will take longer than Friday, please flag which items will be delayed.

Appreciate it —
Emma
